summary: The shared CommandRecipe supplies the actual rootless and inactive caller commands before input binding. The cited native source now prepares a separate private production entry with copied finite command policy, unique root-selected leases, deferred selected cwd capabilities and actual retired-census removal operands; fixed lc_open behavior and UID32768 fixture remain separate. Writable parent and bundle owners derive from the retained keeper's exact mapped namespace UID/GID0, while control cgroups and selected executables retain host-root ownership. Every recipe cwd must equal its selected work-root/bundle path. Original path/inode/mount/nonce joins and no-symlink/escape resolution refuse replacement; visibility concerns selected/live slots rather than deleted historical paths. The real Runner deletes and checks absence of bundlea before selecting bundleb cleanup. Lazy selected-slot buffers retain used evidence; worst-case outputs, copied tables/workspace and an independently admitted overhead reservation must fit the original memory ceiling. Cleanup consumes only the adapter's successful fully captured retired census IDs in observed order, retaining original operation/store/lease origin. Finite EOF and actual bundle absence distinguish clean abort custody from Runner qualification; unknown program/directory retirement holds release. Ordinary source controls use real parser and FD helpers without native effects. Root must independently convert/recompute the typed recipe and authenticate its supplying production controller/profile: digest shape, pure fixture results and compilation provide no such authority. Actual caller/native selector composition, supplying owner, mapped-engine isolation, native8, cold images and receiver acceptance remain unresolved.
title: Finite production custody retains selected native capabilities
